_comment: RHINO v1.0 HEDGE book — always-on tail-risk carry leg of the crisis-alpha fund. NOT stress-gated: each tick it scores the defensive whitelist (gold/oil/dollar/yen) and goes LONG any that is clearly trending up (4h BULLISH + 1h confirm + momentum + RSI room), to carry as standing insurance. SMALL margin_pct (10%) — the position size IS the cost control, the DSL is wide so a crisis winner runs. Leverage clamped to maxLeverage then each asset's HL venue max. Pairs with the ESCALATION book (rhino-escalation-config.json) on a SEPARATE wallet. Set wallet/strategyId/chatId. Runtime owns position tracking, caps, cooldowns, DSL via runtime-hedge.yaml. Producer launched with RHINO_LEG=hedge.
_persona: Tail-risk standing hedge — small persistent LONG in defensives that are trending up, cheap insurance held through calm so you own it when the shock hits. Wide let-it-run DSL, 10d timeout. NOT stress-gated (the stress params here only feed telemetry). Pairs with the convex escalation book.
